cellSize.note: Size of a smoke grid cell. Numerical, not historical.

updateInterval.note: Smoke drifts, thins and spreads in steps of this length. Numerical.

perMusket.note: Density 1 in a cell is a bank that halves the effect of fire through it. A 500-musket volley adds about 1, spread along the battalion's front.

perGun.note: A six-gun salvo adds about 0.9 along the battery's front. A field gun burned a charge of over a kilogram of powder against a musket's few grams, but the cloud rises and spreads.

decayPerSecond.note: Thinning in still air: half gone in about three minutes. Accounts of smoke hanging on windless days suggest minutes, not seconds.

diffusion.unit: fraction per step to each neighbour

hitLoss.note: Fire through smoke is multiplied by 1 / (1 + this x optical depth), where optical depth is density summed along the line of fire in units of one cell.

blockDepth.note: Beyond this the target cannot be seen at all.
